name: solidping
description: Uptime monitoring over MCP: create, run and diagnose checks across 43 types (HTTP, DNS, TLS, databases, queues, browser), read results and incidents, and manage status pages and maintenance windows. Hosted or self-hosted.

http.description: Hosted Streamable HTTP endpoint. Sign-in through OAuth 2.1 (discovery and dynamic client registration), no API key to paste. Self-hosted instances serve the same endpoint at <your base URL>/api/v1/mcp.

examples.title: Create a check
examples.prompt: Create an HTTP check on https://example.com every minute and alert me if it fails.

examples.title: Diagnose a failure
examples.description: Find out why a check is red
examples.prompt: Why is my api.example.com check failing? Run it now and show the last results.

examples.title: Open incidents
examples.prompt: List the open incidents and how long each one has lasted.
